objective: Run planner_joint hybrid ranking with hard_reduction_head frozen to test whether transfer regression comes from disturbing the hard-reduction signal.
required_code_change: Add --train-scope planner_joint_frozen_hard that trains action_encoder, dynamics, reward_head, return_head and freezes hard_reduction_head, online_encoder, target_encoder.

diagnostic_success.transfer_recovery: freezehard transfer hybrid Spearman >= joint_hybrid transfer hybrid Spearman + 0.03
diagnostic_success.safety: freezehard transfer negative_top1_rate <= joint_hybrid transfer negative_top1_rate

promote_if: transfer hybrid Spearman not materially below incumbent
